labels.name: Central lipid droplet
labels.function: Holds triglycerides; lets the cell grow up to 20-fold in diameter

labels.name: Peripheral nucleus
labels.function: Pushed thin against the cell edge by the stored fat

labels.name: Basal lamina
labels.function: Type IV collagen ECM that supports these fragile cells

labels.name: Fibroblast
labels.function: Connective tissue cell found in the septa between fat cells

labels.name: Macrophage
labels.function: Resident immune cell adding pro-inflammatory cytokines

labels.name: Multiple small lipid droplets
labels.function: Many fat stores per cell, typical of newborn thermogenic fat

labels.name: Mitochondria
labels.function: Abundant; give the color and carry UCP1 to make heat

labels.name: Eccentric nucleus
labels.function: Off-center but not pressed flat against the cell edge

labels.name: Capillary
labels.function: Rich supply that carries the generated heat to the body

labels.name: Subcutaneous fat
labels.function: Hip and thigh depot of premenopausal females; may be protective

labels.name: Visceral fat
labels.function: Packed between abdominal organs; tied to insulin resistance, T2DM

labels.name: Breast fat
labels.function: Less radiodense, so masses are easier to see on mammography

labels.name: Marrow fat
labels.function: Lies among hematopoietic cells; from mesenchymal stem cells

labels.name: Brown fat
labels.function: Heat-making depot of neck, shoulders, paravertebral and perirenal areas

labels.name: Hepatic steatosis
labels.function: Fat droplets inside liver cells; may progress to cirrhosis

labels.name: Epicardial fat
labels.function: Ectopic deposit under the heart's outer layer, with fibrosis beneath
